name: va_tower_stepped
notes: The tallest tower in town: 7 m square at the foot, stepping in to 6 m and then 5 m with crenellated ledges, 35 m to the top of a kite flown from the terrace, turquoise and cobalt chequered tile panels. The door is on local -Z under a striped awning; stairs climb ten floors to a terrace with a 1.25 m parapet and a striped canopy. White limewash with cobalt trim since v2.
